note: List prices for the cheapest paid plan that includes PR review, read from each vendor's pricing page on the checked date. Claude rows are measured API cost (list price) of the actual review runs in this eval; the PRs are small (one cricket service each), so larger PRs cost more.

greptile.included: 50 reviews per seat a month (a base review is 1 credit); extra reviews $1 each

coderabbit.price: $24 per developer per month billed annually; $30 billed monthly
coderabbit.included: Unlimited PR reviews, with an hourly per-developer limit

qodo.price: $30 per month for 2,500 credits pooled across the team ($0.012 per credit)
qodo.included: About 18 reviews a month (Qodo's estimate); more reviews draw credits at the same rate, about $1.67 a review

codeant.source_note: codeant.ai/pricing loads its prices in the browser; this is the figure CodeAnt states for itself

claude-plain.plan: Claude API, pay as you go
claude-plain.price: Sonnet 5.5: $2 per M input tokens, $10 per M output, $4 per M 1-hour cache writes, $0.20 per M cache reads
claude-plain.included: Or a Claude Pro subscription at $20 a month ($17 billed annually), which includes Claude Code within its usage limits
